formulae:
bonus(a)  = level(a) + Σ gear(a) + Σ set(a) + Σ passiveRanks(a)      integer, in the stat's storage unit
eff(a)    = base(a) + soft(bonus(a); T(a), K(a))                       base is never compressed
final(a)  = states(eff(a))                                             applied in the tick's status phase
floors    : cost ≥ 1 · windup ≥ 3 ticks · cooldown ≥ 15 ticks · move speed ≥ 0.6 m/s
soft(x; T, K) = x                                   when x ≤ T
              = T + ⌊ K · (x − T) / (K + x − T) ⌋    when x > T
asymptote T + K · marginal value of the next point = K² / (K + x − T)²
v      = channel(skill, rank)                          rank-0..5 value from the kit page
v      = ⌊v × teamDamageScale / 1000⌋                   1.6 / 1.25 / 1.07 / 1.0 by team size (observed)
v      = ⌊v × (100 + damage_eff + vsExposed_eff·exposed) / 100⌋
v      = overdrive roll ?  v × 2  : v                  one roll per hit; never stacks with another doubler
v      = exposed ?  ⌊v × 140 / 100⌋ : v                 Exposed (observed); some riders change 140
a      = max(0, armor − shred − armorPierce)
v      = ⌊v × 100 / (100 + a)⌋                          armor mitigation (observed in core/spatial.ts)
v      = max(1, v − damageReducedFlat)
v      = ⌊v × (100 − damageReducedPct_eff) / 100⌋
v      = counter stance ?  ⌊v × (100 − counter) / 100⌋ : v      (observed)
barrier absorbs ⌊v × (100 − bypass) / 100⌋ first, health takes the rest
fracture roll ?  + ⌊currentHealth / 10⌋ (class I) or ⌊currentHealth / 20⌋ (classes II–IV)
alvl = ilvl − ⌊qlvl / 2⌋     when ilvl < 40 − ⌊qlvl / 2⌋
alvl = 2 × ilvl − 40         otherwise                 (clamped 1–40)
implicit      = roll(base.min, base.max)                       seeded sfc32 (observed)
superior      = ⌊implicit × (110…115) / 100⌋
tempered      = ⌊implicit × (100 + tempered) / 100⌋             local prefix
overclocked   = ⌊implicit × 150 / 100⌋
step          = 5 + resonance                                    % per upgrade level
value(level)  = ⌊rolled × (100 + step × level) / 100⌋            observed with step 5
emitted stat  = Σ values of one attribute across the six slots + set bonuses
loadout       = base + soft(emitted + level + passive ranks)     chapter 03

systems.policy: Declarative roster data; consuming games implement the declared capabilities. Source snapshots retain incompatible historical rules.

item-01.name: keen rift emitter of haste
item-01.flavor: “warning: do not look directly into the aperture. or do, whatever, not my retinas xo.”

item-02.name: tempered rift emitter of resonance
item-02.flavor: it is literally pushing the 30% damage cap on its own... math is terrifying actually n__n.

item-03.name: sturdy veil core of the bulwark
item-03.flavor: chunky, heavy, and will keep your heart ticking even when a missile lands on your noggin.

item-04.name: plated aegis plating of the gale
item-04.flavor: who said tanks can’t sprint?? zoom zoom bestie uwu.

item-05.name: swift seeker lens of might
item-05.flavor: see them before they see you, and delete them before they can even blink :3

item-06.name: mending prism charm of thrift
item-06.flavor: saving team power while keeping the squad alive? queen of corporate budgeting honestly.

item-07.name: grounded weave plating of warding
item-07.flavor: anchors you to the floor so you don’t go flying when big boy mechs throw hands.

item-08.name: far seeker lens of lingering
item-08.flavor: your debuffs will stay rent-free in their minds (and circulatory systems) forever xo.

item-09.name: tempered spark core of resonance
item-09.flavor: tiny battery, gigantic beefcake energy. we love self-improvement ~_~.

item-10.name: keen edge emitter of thrift
item-10.flavor: starter gear that punches way above its weight class. humble king.

item-11.name: plated glass charm of haste
item-11.flavor: light as glass, tough as nails. do not drop it on industrial concrete though.

item-12.name: lingering seeker lens of might
item-12.flavor: makes every single burn and poison stick like glitter after a warehouse rave.

item-13.name: sturdy aegis plating of the bulwark
item-13.flavor: turning your striker into a walking bank vault. you will literally never get one-shot today queen.

item-14.name: far edge emitter of the gale
item-14.flavor: shoot fast, sprint faster, never apologize to corporate security.

item-15.name: tempered aegis plating of warding
item-15.flavor: literally built like a brick fortress. your signature skill drops an extra shield now bestie.

item-16.name: mending glass charm of the bulwark
item-16.flavor: smells like eucalyptus and pure survival instincts. an essential tactical staple :3
